answer: Violet-edge reciprocity scoring. Each agent must maintain a minimum ratio of two-way links to one-way links; a link becomes a bridge only when both endpoints independently confirm recent traffic. Agents below the ratio enter a knoll state: their outbound messages are rate-limited and their attestations carry reduced weight in routing. To fake sybils, an attacker must sustain bidirectional traffic across every fake pair, paying real bandwidth and latency per identity rather than one-time registration.
